rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:

  SELECT geocode_regions AS geocode_regions, description, geocode_level, nuts_version
  FROM eu_territorial_units
  WHERE description ILIKE 'Nordjylland'
  LIMIT 1
),
institutions_in_region AS (
  SELECT
    i.unics_id,
    i.institutions_name,
    i.acronym,
    i.short_name,
    i.country_id,
    i.grid_id,
    i.website,
    i.geocode_regions_3,
    i.db_pedia_url,
    i.wikidata_url,
    i.document_vectors
  FROM institutions i
  JOIN target_region tr
    ON i.geocode_regions_3 = tr.geocode_regions
)
SELECT *
FROM institutions_in_region

    t.title AS title,

    title,

    ec_fund_scheme,
    cordis_ref,
    ec_ref,
    start_date,

    start_year,

    framework_program,

)

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    project AS project,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS member_count
  FROM project_members
  GROUP BY project
)
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_id,
  pmc.member_count
FROM project_member_counts pmc
JOIN projects p
  ON pmc.project = p.unics_id
WHERE pmc.member_count >= 100
ORDER BY pmc.member_count DESC, p.unics_id ASC

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(ec_fund_scheme, ''), '')::text AS ec_fund_scheme
  FROM projects
),
funding_scheme_project_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    p.ec_fund_scheme AS code,
    COUNT(p.unics_id)::bigint AS project_count
  FROM projects_core p
  WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.ec_fund_scheme
)
SELECT
  fs.code,
  fs.title
FROM funding_scheme_project_cohort fspc
JOIN funding_schemes fs ON fs.code = fspc.code
ORDER BY fspc.project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    start_year,
    end_year
  FROM projects
),
projects_duration_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    -- compute duration in years as difference in days divided by 365.25 when dates present,
    -- otherwise fall back to difference of end_year - start_year
    CASE
      WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL
        THEN ((p.end_date - p.start_date) / 365.25)
      WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.end_date IS NULL AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
        THEN ((make_date(p.end_year, 12, 31) - p.start_date) / 365.25)
      WHEN p.start_date IS NULL AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.start_year IS NOT NULL
        THEN ((p.end_date - make_date(p.start_year, 1, 1)) / 365.25)
      WHEN p.start_year IS NOT NULL AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
        THEN ( (p.end_year::numeric) - (p.start_year::numeric) )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS duration_years
  FROM projects_core p
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  duration_years
FROM projects_duration_years
WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  AND duration_years = (
    SELECT MAX(duration_years)
    FROM projects_duration_years m
    WHERE m.start_year IS NOT NULL
      AND m.end_year IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY duration_years DESC, unics_id
